items.text: Full script written from the outline, using the Script Template parts 1 to 9
Every step tested on screen exactly as you will show it (accounts, prompts, settings, downloads)
Script read aloud once; pauses, zooms and graphics marked
Practice files, prompts and links ready in the video's folder
Microphone tested (30-second test, level in the good range, no echo)
Notifications off, other apps closed, private details hidden, browser zoom at 125%
Recorded in sections; first 2 minutes played back and checked
Files named (W01_section01 ...) and backed up to Drive
Camtasia: mistakes and long pauses cut, zoom and highlights added, chapter markers set, timing locked
Audio exported from Camtasia and cleaned in Audition (noise, volume, loudness)
CapCut: clean audio in place and in sync; intro, outro, music, text and captions added
Emails, passwords, phone numbers and other private details hidden or blurred
Final watch at normal speed: the first minute, every demo and the ending
Thumbnail readable on a phone (3 to 5 big words)
Title has Amharic and English keywords
Description: first-line promise, chapters, links, practice files and prompts
Playlist set, end screen and next episode linked, pinned comment ready
Scheduled for Saturday; Edited, Thumbnail and Uploaded ticked in the calendar
Live check: it plays correctly, the audio is good and the chapters show
Shared in your Telegram or social groups
Replied to comments within 24 hours
One Short cut from the video and posted
Views after 7 days written in the calendar
